---
title: "Simulador de devaluación"
subtitle: "Exploración interactiva de escenarios para la industria manufacturera"
toc: true
---

Esta sección permite variar la magnitud del cierre de la brecha entre tipo de
cambio comercial y tipo de cambio de paridad, junto con la intensidad aplicada
a cada coeficiente de incidencia. El valor `100%` reproduce el escenario de
paridad calculado en el XLSX fuente; `0%` reproduce el escenario inicial.

::: {.callout-note}
Los módulos son estáticos y funcionan en el navegador a partir del JSON
preparado por `command-files/analysis-command-files/15_preparar_sitio_entregable_quarto.R`.
:::

<div class="sim-module" data-scenario="Escenario 1 - Comercio Exterior">
  <div class="sim-header">
    <h3>Módulo escenario 1 - Comercio exterior</h3>
    <p>Incidencia directa de importaciones y exportaciones sobre producción, costos, capital e intereses.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sim-content"></div>
</div>

<div class="sim-module" data-scenario="Escenario 2 - Bienes Transables">
  <div class="sim-header">
    <h3>Módulo escenario 2 - Bienes transables</h3>
    <p>Incidencia ampliada sobre bienes transables, incluidos aquellos producidos localmente y vendidos en mercado interno.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sim-content"></div>
</div>

<script>
const DATA_URL = "data/devaluacion_segmentos_20260830.json";
const COLORS = {
  navy: "#0B1F3A",
  deep: "#173B63",
  main: "#2F5F8F",
  steel: "#5F86AD",
  soft: "#9DB8D2",
  pale: "#DCE8F3",
  grey: "#6C7785",
  grid: "#D9E1E8"
};

const SECTIONS = [
  { value: "industria-total", label: "Industria total" },
  { value: "exportadora", label: "Segmento exportador" },
  { value: "mercado-interno", label: "Mercado interno" }
];

const VARIABLES = [
  {
    key: "vbp_pp",
    incidence: "incidencia_vbp_pp",
    delta: "delta_vbp_pp",
    label: "VBP",
    sign: 1,
    affectsCapital: false
  },
  {
    key: "consumo_intermedio_estimado",
    incidence: "incidencia_consumo_intermedio_estimado",
    delta: "delta_consumo_intermedio_estimado",
    label: "Consumo intermedio",
    sign: -1,
    affectsCapital: true
  },
  {
    key: "remuneraciones",
    incidence: "incidencia_remuneraciones",
    delta: "delta_remuneraciones",
    label: "Remuneraciones",
    sign: -1,
    affectsCapital: true
  },
  {
    key: "consumo_capital_fijo",
    incidence: "incidencia_consumo_capital_fijo",
    delta: "delta_consumo_capital_fijo",
    label: "Consumo capital fijo",
    sign: -1,
    affectsCapital: false
  },
  {
    key: "stock_capital_imputado",
    incidence: "incidencia_stock_capital_imputado",
    delta: "delta_stock_capital_imputado",
    label: "Stock imputado",
    sign: 0,
    affectsCapital: true
  },
  {
    key: "intereses_industria_pesos",
    incidence: "incidencia_intereses_industria_pesos",
    delta: "delta_intereses_industria_pesos",
    label: "Intereses",
    sign: 0,
    affectsCapital: false
  }
];

function numberValue(value) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}

function percent(value, digits = 1) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "s/d";
  return `${value.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: digits, minimumFractionDigits: digits })}%`;
}

function moneyBillions(value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "s/d";
  const scaled = value / 1e9;
  return `${scaled.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: 1, minimumFractionDigits: 1 })}`;
}

function pp(value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "s/d";
  return `${value.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: 2, minimumFractionDigits: 2 })} pp`;
}

function computeScenario(row, state) {
  const factorBase = numberValue(row.tipo_cambio_paridad_pesos_usd) / numberValue(row.tipo_cambio_comercial_pesos_usd) - 1;
  const factorEffective = factorBase * state.devaluation / 100;
  const deltas = {};

  VARIABLES.forEach(variable => {
    const base = numberValue(row[variable.key]);
    const incidence = numberValue(row[variable.incidence]);
    const intensity = state.intensities[variable.key] / 100;
    deltas[variable.delta] = base * incidence * intensity * factorEffective;
  });

  const gainBase = numberValue(row.ganancia_pb);
  const capitalBase = numberValue(row.capital_total_adelantado);
  const rotation = numberValue(row.rotacion_calibrada_sobre_6_6);
  const interestsBase = numberValue(row.intereses_industria_pesos);
  const gainPostBase = numberValue(row.ganancia_pb_desp_intereses);

  const gainSim =
    gainBase +
    deltas.delta_vbp_pp -
    deltas.delta_consumo_intermedio_estimado -
    deltas.delta_remuneraciones -
    deltas.delta_consumo_capital_fijo;

  const capitalCirculatingDelta = rotation > 0
    ? (deltas.delta_remuneraciones + deltas.delta_consumo_intermedio_estimado) / rotation
    : 0;

  const capitalSim =
    capitalBase +
    deltas.delta_stock_capital_imputado +
    capitalCirculatingDelta;

  const rateBase = numberValue(row.tasa_ganancia_pb) * 100;
  const rateSim = capitalSim !== 0 ? gainSim / capitalSim * 100 : NaN;
  const interestsSim = interestsBase + deltas.delta_intereses_industria_pesos;
  const gainPostSim = gainSim - interestsSim;
  const ratePostSim = capitalSim !== 0 ? gainPostSim / capitalSim * 100 : NaN;
  const saldo = gainBase - gainSim;
  const deltaPct = gainBase !== 0 ? (gainSim - gainBase) / gainBase * 100 : NaN;
  const saldoPost = gainPostBase - gainPostSim;

  const components = [
    { label: "VBP", value: -deltas.delta_vbp_pp },
    { label: "Consumo intermedio", value: deltas.delta_consumo_intermedio_estimado },
    { label: "Remuneraciones", value: deltas.delta_remuneraciones },
    { label: "Consumo capital fijo", value: deltas.delta_consumo_capital_fijo },
    { label: "Stock imputado", value: deltas.delta_stock_capital_imputado },
    { label: "Intereses", value: deltas.delta_intereses_industria_pesos }
  ].map(component => ({
    ...component,
    pctGain: gainBase !== 0 ? component.value / gainBase * 100 : NaN
  }));

  return {
    factorBase,
    factorEffective,
    deltas,
    gainBase,
    gainSim,
    gainPostBase,
    gainPostSim,
    capitalBase,
    capitalSim,
    rateBase,
    rateSim,
    ratePostSim,
    saldo,
    saldoPost,
    deltaPct,
    components
  };
}

function barSvg(values, options = {}) {
  const width = 520;
  const height = 210;
  const margin = { top: 16, right: 20, bottom: 48, left: 54 };
  const innerW = width - margin.left - margin.right;
  const innerH = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
  const minValue = Math.min(0, ...values.map(d => d.value));
  const maxValue = Math.max(0, ...values.map(d => d.value));
  const range = maxValue - minValue || 1;
  const barW = innerW / values.length * 0.56;
  const yFor = value => margin.top + (maxValue - value) / range * innerH;
  const zeroY = yFor(0);

  const bars = values.map((d, i) => {
    const x = margin.left + i * innerW / values.length + (innerW / values.length - barW) / 2;
    const valueY = yFor(d.value);
    const h = Math.abs(valueY - zeroY);
    const y = d.value >= 0 ? valueY : zeroY;
    const color = d.color || COLORS.main;
    const labelY = d.value >= 0 ? y - 6 : y + h + 14;
    return `
      <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${barW}" height="${h}" fill="${color}" rx="3"></rect>
      <text x="${x + barW / 2}" y="${height - 22}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${COLORS.grey}" font-size="12">${d.label}</text>
      <text x="${x + barW / 2}" y="${labelY}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${COLORS.navy}" font-size="12" font-weight="650">${d.format(d.value)}</text>
    `;
  }).join("");

  return `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" width="100%" height="auto">
      <line x1="${margin.left}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y1="${zeroY}" y2="${zeroY}" stroke="${COLORS.grid}" stroke-width="1"></line>
      ${bars}
    </svg>
  `;
}

function horizontalBarsSvg(values) {
  const width = 560;
  const height = 250;
  const margin = { top: 18, right: 70, bottom: 22, left: 150 };
  const innerW = width - margin.left - margin.right;
  const rowH = (height - margin.top - margin.bottom) / values.length;
  const max = Math.max(...values.map(d => Math.abs(d.pctGain)), 1);
  const zeroX = margin.left + innerW / 2;

  const bars = values.map((d, i) => {
    const y = margin.top + i * rowH + rowH * 0.24;
    const w = Math.abs(d.pctGain) / max * innerW / 2;
    const x = d.pctGain >= 0 ? zeroX : zeroX - w;
    const color = d.pctGain >= 0 ? COLORS.deep : COLORS.soft;
    const textX = d.pctGain >= 0 ? x + w + 6 : x - 6;
    const anchor = d.pctGain >= 0 ? "start" : "end";
    return `
      <text x="${margin.left - 8}" y="${y + 13}" text-anchor="end" fill="${COLORS.navy}" font-size="12">${d.label}</text>
      <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${rowH * 0.52}" fill="${color}" rx="3"></rect>
      <text x="${textX}" y="${y + 13}" text-anchor="${anchor}" fill="${COLORS.grey}" font-size="12">${percent(d.pctGain)}</text>
    `;
  }).join("");

  return `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" width="100%" height="auto">
      <line x1="${zeroX}" x2="${zeroX}" y1="${margin.top}" y2="${height - margin.bottom}" stroke="${COLORS.grey}" stroke-width="1"></line>
      ${bars}
    </svg>
  `;
}

function renderModule(module, data) {
  const scenario = module.dataset.scenario;
  const rows = data.filter(row => row.escenario === scenario && SECTIONS.some(section => section.value === row.seccion));
  const years = [...new Set(rows.map(row => Number(row.anno)))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const container = module.querySelector(".sim-content");
  const state = {
    year: Math.max(...years),
    section: "industria-total",
    devaluation: 100,
    intensities: Object.fromEntries(VARIABLES.map(variable => [variable.key, 100]))
  };

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sim-layout">
      <div class="sim-controls">
        <div class="control-row">
          <label>Año</label>
          <select data-control="year">${years.map(year => `<option value="${year}">${year}</option>`).join("")}</select>
        </div>
        <div class="control-row">
          <label>Sección</label>
          <select data-control="section">${SECTIONS.map(section => `<option value="${section.value}">${section.label}</option>`).join("")}</select>
        </div>
        <div class="control-row">
          <label>Magnitud de devaluación</label>
          <input type="range" min="0" max="150" step="1" value="100" data-control="devaluation">
          <div class="control-value" data-value="devaluation">100%</div>
        </div>
        ${VARIABLES.map(variable => `
          <div class="control-row">
            <label>${variable.label}</label>
            <input type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="100" data-control="${variable.key}">
            <div class="control-value" data-value="${variable.key}">100%</div>
          </div>
        `).join("")}
        <button class="reset-button" type="button">Restaurar escenario XLSX</button>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="metrics-grid" data-role="metrics"></div>
        <div class="chart-row">
          <div class="chart-box">
            <h4>Tasa de ganancia a precios básicos</h4>
            <div data-role="rate-chart"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-box">
            <h4>Saldo y variación de ganancia</h4>
            <div data-role="saldo-chart"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chart-box" style="margin-top: 1rem;">
          <h4>Componentes como porcentaje de la ganancia inicial</h4>
          <div data-role="components-chart"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="sim-table" data-role="summary-table"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  container.querySelector('[data-control="year"]').value = state.year;
  container.querySelector('[data-control="section"]').value = state.section;

  function update() {
    const row = rows.find(item => Number(item.anno) === state.year && item.seccion === state.section);
    if (!row) {
      container.querySelector('[data-role="metrics"]').innerHTML = "<p>No hay datos disponibles para la selección.</p>";
      return;
    }
    const result = computeScenario(row, state);
    const sectionLabel = SECTIONS.find(section => section.value === state.section)?.label || state.section;

    container.querySelector('[data-value="devaluation"]').textContent = `${state.devaluation}%`;
    VARIABLES.forEach(variable => {
      container.querySelector(`[data-value="${variable.key}"]`).textContent = `${state.intensities[variable.key]}%`;
    });

    container.querySelector('[data-role="metrics"]').innerHTML = `
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Selección</span><strong>${sectionLabel}</strong></div>
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Factor efectivo</span><strong>${percent(result.factorEffective * 100)}</strong></div>
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Ganancia inicial</span><strong>${moneyBillions(result.gainBase)}</strong></div>
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Ganancia simulada</span><strong>${moneyBillions(result.gainSim)}</strong></div>
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Saldo sobrevaluación</span><strong>${moneyBillions(result.saldo)}</strong></div>
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Variación ganancia</span><strong>${percent(result.deltaPct)}</strong></div>
    `;

    container.querySelector('[data-role="rate-chart"]').innerHTML = barSvg([
      { label: "Inicial", value: result.rateBase, color: COLORS.navy, format: value => percent(value, 2) },
      { label: "Simulada", value: result.rateSim, color: COLORS.main, format: value => percent(value, 2) }
    ]);

    container.querySelector('[data-role="saldo-chart"]').innerHTML = barSvg([
      { label: "Saldo", value: result.saldo / 1e9, color: result.saldo >= 0 ? COLORS.deep : COLORS.soft, format: value => `${value.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: 1, minimumFractionDigits: 1 })}` },
      { label: "Delta %", value: result.deltaPct, color: COLORS.steel, format: value => percent(value) }
    ]);

    container.querySelector('[data-role="components-chart"]').innerHTML = horizontalBarsSvg(result.components);

    container.querySelector('[data-role="summary-table"]').innerHTML = `
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Indicador</th>
            <th>Escenario inicial</th>
            <th>Simulación</th>
            <th>Diferencia</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Ganancia pb</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.gainBase)}</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.gainSim)}</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.gainSim - result.gainBase)}</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Tasa ganancia pb</td><td>${percent(result.rateBase, 2)}</td><td>${percent(result.rateSim, 2)}</td><td>${pp(result.rateSim - result.rateBase)}</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Ganancia pb post intereses</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.gainPostBase)}</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.gainPostSim)}</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.gainPostSim - result.gainPostBase)}</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Saldo sobrevaluación</td><td></td><td>${moneyBillions(result.saldo)}</td><td>${percent(result.deltaPct)}</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Capital total adelantado</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.capitalBase)}</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.capitalSim)}</td><td>${moneyBillions(result.capitalSim - result.capitalBase)}</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p class="source-note">Montos en miles de millones de pesos corrientes. Las tasas se expresan como porcentaje.</p>
    `;
  }

  container.addEventListener("input", event => {
    const control = event.target.dataset.control;
    if (!control) return;
    if (control === "year") state.year = Number(event.target.value);
    if (control === "section") state.section = event.target.value;
    if (control === "devaluation") state.devaluation = Number(event.target.value);
    if (VARIABLES.some(variable => variable.key === control)) state.intensities[control] = Number(event.target.value);
    update();
  });

  container.addEventListener("click", event => {
    if (!event.target.classList.contains("reset-button")) return;
    state.devaluation = 100;
    VARIABLES.forEach(variable => state.intensities[variable.key] = 100);
    container.querySelector('[data-control="devaluation"]').value = 100;
    VARIABLES.forEach(variable => {
      container.querySelector(`[data-control="${variable.key}"]`).value = 100;
    });
    update();
  });

  update();
}

fetch(DATA_URL)
  .then(response => {
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`No se pudo cargar ${DATA_URL}`);
    return response.json();
  })
  .then(data => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".sim-module").forEach(module => renderModule(module, data));
  })
  .catch(error => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".sim-content").forEach(container => {
      container.innerHTML = `<p>No se pudo cargar el módulo interactivo: ${error.message}</p>`;
    });
  });
</script>

## Nota técnica

La simulación aplica:

```text
factor_efectivo = intensidad_devaluacion * (tipo_cambio_paridad / tipo_cambio_comercial - 1)
```

Cada variable afectada usa su coeficiente de incidencia y el porcentaje elegido
en el slider correspondiente. El stock imputado incide en el capital total
adelantado; los intereses inciden en la ganancia post intereses.
